style.vernacular: A European-feeling grid city built 1880-1930 by Italian and Spanish immigrants: stuccoed Italianate and French-academic apartment buildings of 4-8 storeys with cornices, balustrades and iron balconies, zinc-clad mansard roofs with dormers, low casas chorizo and conventillos with flat roofs behind decorative parapets, art-deco and rationalist blocks after 1930, and brick-and-render suburbs. Concrete and brick towers and 1970s freeways in the later city; plane trees (platanos), jacarandas and gums line paved streets.
style.ornament: Stucco cornices, pilasters and balustrades imitating Paris stone; wrought-iron balconies and Juliet railings; zinc mansard roofs with oeil-de-boeuf dormers and domed corner pavilions; carved lintels and caryatids; coloured tile (azulejo) panels; Beaux-Arts clock domes on civic buildings; painted shop awnings and hand-lettered signs.

sources.what: eclectic preserved European architecture of 1880-1930 growth, conventillos, landmarks (Congress, Casa Rosada, Palacio Barolo), parks and trees
Italianate / Beaux-Arts civic palace in imitation Paris stone render now painted, with mansard-capped domes and iron details
